notes.text: This is a handwritten drawing sheet. Dark ink, lighter pencil strokes and two green strokes occur. The lighter heading and foliation are retained without assigning a named writer. No typescript is transcribed on this page.

The total remains 17|14, with 17 first. The listed quantities give 2+3+6+6=17, while the separately written parenthesis after deletion is 14=3×4+2. Both source readings are retained; arithmetic is not used to decide the overwrite order.
The first 1 is dark and retraced. H claims a prior numeral, but no prior numeral is identified securely in the crop; no invented underlying text is added.

The type phrase is physically interlinear below trouver; its precise linear attachment remains uncertain. The cancelled glyph before the first J is separate from that J. Both live letters have a left-hooked foot and are read J.

TikZ is a schematic diplomatic reproduction of the visible geometry, retaining ring and point distinctions, dashed connections, directions, free ends and green strokes. The crossing arrow cluster, small contact strokes and heavily retraced rings remain approximate and are nominated for blind rereading.
No explicit date was read on this page. The handwritten 23 is retained as marginal foliation without assigning its hand.
The source forms ens and card are left unexpanded. No period is added after ens where H supplied one.

The page associates three elements with 3×2=6 elliptic cartes of type (1,1), writes diag_Q ≃ omega_Q and diag_Q wedge omega_Q ≃ codiag_Q, and enumerates canonical constructions from a four-element set. These are recorded as source claims; the only mathematical checks performed here are the three elementary computations K24-01 through K24-03.
